cards.ans: What does it look like?
cards.mark: What does it look like?
cards.key: does it 連在一起，聽起來像一個字 [ˋdʌzɪt]。
cards.expl: does 最後的 [z] 直接接上 it 的 [ɪ]；it 的 t 碰到 look，省略不念。情境是男士在失物招領處問外套長什麼樣子，it 就是那件外套。
dis: What does he look like?
does he 的 h 在句中常常不發音，會念成 [ˋdʌzi]，母音拉長、後面沒有 t 那一下停頓；錄音裡是短短的 [ɪt]。
What did it look like?
did 的母音是 [ɪ]，而且字尾是 [d]；錄音裡是 [ʌ] 接 [z]。
What do they look like?
do they 中間有明顯的 [ð] 和 [e]；錄音裡 does 的 [z] 直接接 [ɪ]。

cards.ans: Have you taken anything?
cards.mark: Have you taken anything?
cards.key: taken 的 [n] 接到 anything 上，聽起來像 [nɛnɪθɪŋ]。
cards.expl: 句首的 Have you 念得又輕又快，只剩 [həvjə]，很容易漏掉。情境是男生說頭痛，女生問他吃藥了沒，take 在這裡是「吃（藥）」。
dis: Can you take anything?
take 後面沒有 [ən]，taken 的 [n] 正是連到 anything 的那個音；句首是輕讀的 have you，不是 can you。
Have you eaten anything?
eaten 開頭是母音 [i]，錄音裡 you 後面接的是 [t] 開頭的 taken。
Did you take anything?
did you 會同化成 [ˋdɪdʒu]；錄音裡句首是 [həvjə]，後面是 taken。

cards.ans: Should I open the present now or should I wait until I get home?
cards.mark: Should I open the present now or should I wait until I get home?
cards.key: I 和 open 中間多出一個像 y 的音，聽起來像 [aɪ jopən]。
cards.expl: 兩個母音碰在一起的時候，中間會自然帶出 [j] 或 [w]，把兩個字接起來。前面的 Should I 也連在一起，念成 [ʃʊˋdaɪ]。
dis: Should I open the present now or should I wait till I get home?
till 念成 [tɪl]；錄音裡 wait 後面還有 un-，wait 的 t 接上去，念成 [we tʌnˋtɪl]。
Should I open the present now or should I wait until you get home?
until you 會念成 [ʌnˋtɪlju]；錄音裡 until 的 [l] 接的是 [aɪ]，念成 [ʌnˋtɪlaɪ]。
Shall I open the present now or should I wait until I get home?
shall I 念成 [ʃəˋlaɪ]，中間是 [l]；錄音裡是 should 的 [d] 接到 I，念成 [ʃʊˋdaɪ]。

cards.ans: Do you mind if I take a day off from work next week?
cards.mark: Do you mind if I take a day off from work next week?
cards.key: day off 中間多出一個像 y 的音，聽起來像 [de jɔf]。
cards.expl: 同一句裡的 mind if I 也連成一串，念成 [maɪn dɪ faɪ]；next week 的 t 夾在 [s] 和 [w] 中間，幾乎聽不到。
dis: Do you mind if I take the day off from work next week?
the 念成 [ðə]，會有 [ð] 這個音；錄音裡 take 後面只有一個輕輕的 [ə]。
Do you mind if I take days off from work next week?
days 字尾有 [z]，會連到 off 念成 [dezɔf]；錄音裡中間是像 y 的音，不是 [z]。
Do you mind if I take a day off from work next weekend?
weekend 後面還有 [ɛnd]；錄音裡 week 就結束了。

cards.ans: Have you tried the new restaurant next to our school?
cards.mark: Have you tried the new restaurant next to our school?
cards.key: next to 的兩個 t 只念一次，聽起來像 [nɛks tə]。
cards.expl: to 念得很輕，只剩 [tə]；後面接 our 的時候，中間多出一個像 w 的音，念成 [tə waʊr]。
dis: Have you tried the new restaurant next to your school?
your 開頭是像 y 的音；錄音裡 to 後面接的是 our，中間多出一個像 w 的音。
Have you tried the new restaurant next door to our school?
next door 中間會有 [d] 和 [ɔr]；錄音裡 next 後面直接接 [tə]。
Have you tried the new restaurant near our school?
near 念成 [nɪr]，沒有 [ks] 和 [t]；錄音裡聽得到 next 的 [ks]。

cards.ans: I guess you just don't like it.
cards.mark: I guess you just don't like it.
cards.key: guess you 的 [s] 碰到 you，變成 [ʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋgɛʃu]。
cards.expl: 後面的 just don't，just 的 t 夾在 [s] 和 [d] 中間，幾乎聽不到，念成 [dʒʌs dont]。
dis: I guess she just doesn't like it.
guess she 也會念成 [gɛʃi]，差別在後面：she 配 doesn't，會多一個 [z]；錄音裡是 don't。
I guess you just didn't like it.
didn't 念成 [ˋdɪdn̩t]，母音是 [ɪ]；錄音裡是 don't 的 [o]。
I guess you don't like it.
少了 just；錄音裡 you 和 don't 中間聽得到 [dʒʌs]。

cards.ans: What's your school bag doing on the kitchen table?
cards.mark: What's your school bag doing on the kitchen table?
cards.key: what's your 的 [s] 碰到 your，變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋhwɑtʃɚ]。
cards.expl: your 念得很輕，只剩 [jɚ]，整段很容易聽成別的字。情境是有人看到書包放在廚房的餐桌上，覺得不該放在那裡。
dis: What's her school bag doing on the kitchen table?
her 的 h 在句中常常不發音，what's her 會念成 [ˋhwɑtsɚ]，跟錄音很像；差別在錄音裡的 [s] 碰到 your 的 [j]，變成了 [tʃ]。
What's the school bag doing on the kitchen table?
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 what's 後面是 [tʃ] 接輕讀的 [ɚ]。
Why is your school bag lying on the kitchen table?
why is 念成 [hwaɪ ɪz]，母音是 [aɪ]，後面也不是 doing；錄音裡是 [hwɑtʃɚ]。

cards.ans: Do you know what you want to major in at university?
cards.mark: Do you know what you want to major in at university?
cards.key: want to 的兩個 t 只念一次，說得快的時候變成 [ˋwɑnə]。
cards.expl: 前面的 what you 也會變音：t 碰到 you 變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋhwɑtʃu]。major in 則連在一起，念成 [ˋmedʒɚ rɪn]。
dis: Do you know what you wanted to major in at university?
wanted 後面有 [ɪd]，會念成 [ˋwɑntɪd tə]；錄音裡 want 的 t 只出現一次。
Do you know what we want to major in at university?
what we 的 t 接 [w]，不會變成 [tʃ]；錄音裡是 [hwɑtʃu]。
Do you know what you'd like to major in at university?
you'd like 會有 [d] 和 [laɪk]；錄音裡是 [wɑnə]。

cards.ans: When I was crossing the street, someone tapped me on the shoulder.
cards.mark: When I was crossing the street, someone tapped me on the shoulder.
cards.key: tapped 最後的 [t] 幾乎聽不到，tapped me 聽起來像 tap me。
cards.expl: -ed 的 [t] 夾在 [p] 和 me 的 [m] 中間，省略不念。聽不出 -ed 的時候，可以靠前面的 was crossing 知道這是過去的事。
dis: When I was crossing the street, someone touched me on the shoulder.
touched 念成 [tʌtʃt]，母音是 [ʌ]，中間還有 [tʃ]；錄音裡是 [æ] 和 [p]。
When I was crossing the street, someone tapped my shoulder.
my 念成 [maɪ]；錄音裡是 me [mi]，後面還有 on the。
When I was crossing the street, someone tapped him on the shoulder.
him 的 h 在句中常常不發音，會念成 [ɪm]；錄音裡是 [mi]。

cards.ans: I'd better go to the grocery store.
cards.mark: I'd better go to the grocery store.
cards.key: I'd 的 [d] 碰到 better 的 [b]，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 I better。
cards.expl: had better 表示「最好（去做）」；冰箱裡快沒有吃的了，所以她要去買東西。
dis: I'll go to the grocery store.
I'll 念成 [aɪl]，而且沒有 better；錄音裡聽得到 [ˋbɛtɚ]。
I'd rather go to the grocery store.
rather 念成 [ˋræðɚ]，開頭是 [r]；錄音裡是 [b]。
I have to go to the grocery store.
have to 念成 [ˋhæftə]；錄音裡 I 後面直接接 better。

cards.ans: I keep them in my bag.
cards.mark: I keep them in my bag.
cards.key: them 念得很輕，只剩 [əm]，keep them in 聽起來像 [ˋkipəmɪn]。
cards.expl: 代名詞在句子裡通常念得很輕，them 的 [ð] 常常聽不到。them 指的是男生自己帶的筷子。
dis: I keep it in my bag.
it 念成 [ɪt]，會連成 [kipɪtɪn]；錄音裡 keep 後面是 [əm]。
I kept them in my bag.
kept 的母音是短音 [ɛ]，字尾還有 [t]；錄音裡是長音 [i] 的 keep。而且這是他每天的習慣，要用現在式。
I keep one in my bag.
one 念成 [wʌn]，開頭有 [w]；錄音裡是 [əm]。

cards.ans: Just give me five minutes to get ready.
cards.mark: Just give me five minutes to get ready.
cards.key: give me 的 [v] 幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 [ˋgɪmi]。
cards.expl: me 念得很輕，接在 give 後面像一個字；後面 get ready 的 t 也省略不念。
dis: Just give it five minutes to get ready.
give it 會連成 [ˋgɪvɪt]；錄音裡是 [gɪmi]。
Just give him five minutes to get ready.
him 的 h 常常不發音，會念成 [ˋgɪvɪm]，聽得到 [v]；錄音裡是 [gɪmi]。
Just give me five minutes to get there.
there 念成 [ðɛr]；錄音裡是 [ˋrɛdɪ]。

cards.ans: Have you bought a ticket for the exhibition?
cards.mark: Have you bought a ticket for the exhibition?
cards.key: bought 的 t 接上 a，聽起來像一個字 [ˋbɔtə]。
cards.expl: t 夾在兩個母音中間的時候，常常念得很快，接近輕輕的 d。句首的 Have you 念得又輕又快，只剩 [həvjə]。情境是男生問女生買了埃及木乃伊展的票沒有。
dis: Have you got a ticket for the exhibition?
got a 念成 [ˋgɑtə]，開頭是 [g]，母音要張大嘴；錄音裡是 [bɔ]。
Have you bought the ticket for the exhibition?
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 bought 後面直接接一個輕輕的 [ə]。
Did you buy a ticket for the exhibition?
did you 會連成 [ˋdɪdʒu]，buy a 中間多出一個像 y 的音；錄音裡句首是輕讀的 [həvjə]，後面是 bought。

cards.ans: Blood was running down her arm.
cards.mark: Blood was running down her arm.
cards.key: her 最後的 r 接到 arm 上，聽起來像 [hɚ rɑrm]。
cards.expl: her 的捲舌音直接接上 arm 開頭的母音，兩個字連成一串。情境是飛機劇烈搖晃，一位空服員跌倒撞傷了頭，血順著手臂流下來。
dis: Blood was running down his arm.
his 最後的 [z] 會接到 arm，念成 [hɪˋzɑrm]；錄音裡中間是捲舌的 r。
Blood was running down her arms.
arms 最後有 [z]；錄音裡 arm 就結束了。
Blood is running down her arm.
is 念成 [ɪz]；錄音裡 blood 後面是 was [wəz]，聽得到 [w]。

cards.ans: And why is that a problem?
cards.mark: And why is that a problem?
cards.key: why 和 is 中間多出一個像 y 的音，聽起來像 [hwaɪ jɪz]。
cards.expl: 兩個母音碰在一起的時候，中間會自然帶出像 y 或 w 的音，把兩個字接起來。後面的 that a 也連在一起，t 念得像輕輕的 d，聽起來像 [ðædə]。情境是女生說有錢的叔叔什麼都有，男生不懂這為什麼是問題。
dis: And why was that a problem?
why was 中間是 was 開頭的 [w]，母音也不一樣；錄音裡 why 後面是像 y 的音接 [ɪz]。
And how is that a problem?
how is 中間多出的是像 w 的音，念成 [haʊ wɪz]；錄音裡是 [hwaɪ jɪz]，中間是像 y 的音。
And why isn't that a problem?
isn't 後面有 [nt]，念成 [ˋɪznt]；錄音裡 is 後面直接接 that。

cards.ans: Who is trying to call you?
cards.mark: Who is trying to call you?
cards.key: who 和 is 中間多出一個像 w 的音，聽起來像 [hu wɪz]。
cards.expl: 嘴唇收圓的 [u] 後面接母音時，中間常帶出像 w 的音。trying to 的 to 念得很輕，只剩 [tə]。情境是女生的手機一直響，男生問是誰打來的。
dis: Who was trying to call you?
was 的母音是輕輕的 [ə]，念成 [hu wəz]；錄音裡 who 後面是 [wɪz]。
Who is trying to call him?
him 的 h 常常不發音，call him 念成 [ˋkɔlɪm]；錄音裡 call 後面是 you [ju]。
Who is going to call you?
going to 念成 [ˋgoɪŋ tə]；錄音裡是 trying [ˋtraɪɪŋ]，開頭有 [tr]。

cards.ans: Let’s start with some basic definitions.
cards.mark: Let’s start with some basic definitions.
cards.key: let's 最後的 [s] 和 start 開頭的 [s] 只念一次，聽起來像 [lɛt stɑrt]。
cards.expl: 兩個一樣的子音碰在一起，只念一次。start with 的 t 碰到 with，省略不念；some 的 [m] 和 basic 的 [b] 都要閉上嘴唇，接得很緊。這是運動中心介紹 Tabata 訓練的開場。
dis: Let us start with some basic definitions.
let us 分開念 [lɛt ʌs]，中間聽得到母音 [ʌ]；錄音裡 let 後面直接接 start。
Let’s start with the basic definitions.
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 with 後面是 some [sʌm]。
Let’s start off with some basic definitions.
start off 會連成 [stɑrˋtɔf]，多出一個 off；錄音裡 start 後面直接接 with。

cards.ans: A girl is raising her hand to ask questions about smoking.
cards.mark: A girl is raising her hand to ask questions about smoking.
cards.key: ask 的 [k] 和 questions 的 [k] 只念一次，聽起來像 [æs kwɛstʃənz]。
cards.expl: 前一個 [k] 省略不念，只念後一個。前面的 raising her hand，her 的 h 常常不發音，念成 [ˋrezɪŋ ɚ hænd]。這一句是圖片題的選項 (D)；照片裡的女生舉起的是禁菸標誌，不是舉手發問。
dis: A girl is raising her hand to answer questions about smoking.
answer 念成 [ˋænsɚ]，中間有 [n]；錄音裡是 [æs]，後面緊接 [kw]。
A girl is raising her hand to ask a question about smoking.
ask a question 中間多一個輕輕的 [ə]，question 也沒有最後的 [z]；錄音裡 ask 直接接 questions。
A girl is raising a hand to ask questions about smoking.
a 念成 [ə]；錄音裡 raising 後面是 her，h 不發音，念成捲舌的 [ɚ]。

cards.ans: How was your trip?
cards.mark: How was your trip?
cards.key: was 的 [z] 碰到 your，變成 [ʒ]，聽起來像 [wəʒɚ]。
cards.expl: [z] 碰到 your 開頭像 y 的音，兩個音合成 [ʒ]，就是 usually 中間那個音。your 念得很輕，只剩 [jɚ]。情境是男生旅行回來，女生問他這趟旅行怎麼樣。
dis: How was their trip?
their 念成 [ðɛr]，開頭是 [ð]；錄音裡 was 後面是 [ʒɚ]。
How was her trip?
her 的 h 常常不發音，was her 念成 [ˋwəzɚ]，還是 [z]；錄音裡 [z] 已經變成 [ʒ]。
How was his trip?
his 念成 [ɪz]，was his 聽起來像 [wəzɪz]，多一個 [ɪz]；錄音裡是 [wəʒɚ]。

cards.ans: It helps you to burn calories and build muscles.
cards.mark: It helps you to burn calories and build muscles.
cards.key: helps 的 [s] 碰到 you，變成 [ʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋhɛlpʃu]。
cards.expl: to 念得很輕，只剩 [tə]；build muscles 的 [d] 碰到 [m]，省略不念。這一句在介紹 Tabata 訓練對健康的好處。
dis: It helped you to burn calories and build muscles.
helped 最後是 [t]，碰到 you 會變成 [tʃ]，念成 [ˋhɛlptʃu]；錄音裡是 [ʃ]，沒有 t 那一下。
It helps us to burn calories and build muscles.
helps us 會連成 [ˋhɛlpsəs]，還是 [s]；錄音裡 [s] 碰到 you，變成了 [ʃ]。
It helps you to burn calories and build muscle.
muscle 沒有最後的 [z]；錄音裡句尾聽得到 [z]。

cards.ans: I watched an award-winning movie last night.
cards.mark: I watched an award-winning movie last night.
cards.key: last 的 t 夾在 [s] 和 [n] 中間，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 [læs naɪt]。
cards.expl: 前面的 watched an 連在一起，念成 [ˋwɑtʃtən]。award-winning 是「得過獎的」；說話的人接著說，這部電影沒有想像中好看。
dis: I watched an award-winning movie that night.
that 開頭是 [ð]；錄音裡 movie 後面是 [l]。
I watched an award-winning movie late last night.
late 會多出 [let]；錄音裡 movie 後面直接接 last。
I watch an award-winning movie every night.
watch an 沒有 -ed 的 [t]，句尾也是 every night；錄音裡是 [læs naɪt]。

cards.ans: That saved more people from being hurt.
cards.mark: That saved more people from being hurt.
cards.key: saved 的 [d] 碰到 more 的 [m]，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 save more。
cards.expl: -ed 的 [d] 夾在 [v] 和 [m] 中間，省略不念。聽不出 -ed 的時候，要靠上下文判斷：前一句說大部分乘客都繫著安全帶，可見這是過去發生的事。
dis: That saves more people from being hurt.
saves 最後有 [z]，會接到 more，念成 [sevz mɔr]；錄音裡 [v] 後面直接接 [m]。
That saved many people from being hurt.
many 念成 [ˋmɛnɪ]；錄音裡是 more [mɔr]，聽得到捲舌。
That saved more people from getting hurt.
getting 念成 [ˋgɛtɪŋ]，開頭是 [g]；錄音裡是 being [ˋbiɪŋ]。

cards.ans: I’ll talk to him later.
cards.mark: I’ll talk to him later.
cards.key: him 的 h 不發音，只剩 [ɪm]，talk to him 聽起來像 [ˋtɔk tə ɪm]。
cards.expl: 代名詞在句子裡通常念得很輕，him、her 開頭的 h 常常聽不到；to 也只剩 [tə]。情境是女生的男朋友一直打電話來，她說晚一點再跟他講。
dis: I’ll talk to her later.
her 的 h 也常常不發音，念成捲舌的 [ɚ]；錄音裡是閉上嘴唇的 [ɪm]。
I’ll talk with him later.
with 念成 [wɪð]，有 [ð]；錄音裡 talk 後面是輕輕的 [tə]。
I’ll call him later.
call 念成 [kɔl]，開頭是 [k]，後面也沒有 to；錄音裡是 talk to。

cards.ans: I guess I’ll talk to them again when they’re in a better mood.
cards.mark: I guess I’ll talk to them again when they’re in a better mood.
cards.kk: talk to them again [tɔk] [tu] [ðɛm] [əˋgɛn] → [ˋtɔk tə ðəməˋgɛn]
cards.key: them 念得很輕，只剩 [ðəm]，又接上 again，聽起來像 [tɔk tə ðə məgɛn]。
cards.expl: them 的 [m] 接上 again 開頭的 [ə]，兩個字連在一起；to 也只剩 [tə]。前面的 guess I'll 連成 [gɛˋsaɪl]。情境是女生和爸媽大吵一架，決定等他們氣消了再談。
dis: I guess I’ll talk to him again when he’s in a better mood.
him 的 h 不發音，念成 [ɪm]，後面也是 he's [hiz]；錄音裡是 [ðəm]，後面是 they're [ðɚ]。
I guess I’d talk to them again when they’re in a better mood.
I'd 的 [d] 碰到 talk，只剩 [aɪ]；錄音裡 guess 後面是 I'll，聽得到 [l]。
I guess I’ll talk to them again when they’re in a much better mood.
much 念成 [mʌtʃ]；錄音裡 a 後面直接接 better [ˋbɛtɚ]。

cards.ans: Can we go to the coffee shop around the corner instead?
cards.mark: Can we go to the coffee shop around the corner instead?
cards.key: shop 的 [p] 接到 around 上，聽起來像 [ʃɑ pəraʊnd]。
cards.expl: around 開頭的 [ə] 很輕，接在 [p] 後面，很容易聽成一個字。around the corner 的 [d] 碰到 the，也幾乎聽不到。情境是女生想去圖書館準備考試，男生說他在安靜的地方讀不下書。
dis: Can we go to the coffee shops around the corner instead?
shops 最後有 [s]，會連成 [ʃɑpsəˋraʊnd]；錄音裡 [p] 直接接 around。
Can we go to a coffee shop around the corner instead?
a 只念 [ə]；錄音裡 to 後面是 the [ðə]，聽得到 [ð]。
Could we go to the coffee shop around the corner instead?
could 念成 [kʊd]；錄音裡句首是 can [kən]。

cards.ans: I took a taxi home from the Grand Hotel.
cards.mark: I took a taxi home from the Grand Hotel.
cards.key: took 的 [k] 接上 a，聽起來像一個字 [ˋtʊkə]。
cards.expl: a 只念一個輕輕的 [ə]，接在 took 後面，很容易漏聽。情境是女生打電話到計程車行，說她把筆記型電腦忘在計程車上。
dis: I took the taxi home from the Grand Hotel.
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 took 後面直接接輕輕的 [ə]。
I got a taxi home from the Grand Hotel.
got a 念成 [ˋgɑtə]，開頭是 [g]，母音要張大嘴；錄音裡是 [tʊkə]。
I’ll take a taxi home from the Grand Hotel.
take a 念成 [ˋtekə]，母音是 [e]，句首也多了 I'll 的 [l]；錄音裡是短短的 [ʊ]。

cards.ans: How about that one over there?
cards.mark: How about that one over there?
cards.key: how 和 about 中間多出一個像 w 的音，聽起來像 [haʊ wəbaʊt]。
cards.expl: about 最後的 t 碰到 that，省略不念；one over 的 [n] 接上 over，念成 [wʌ ˋnovɚ]。情境是兩人在店裡挑禮物，男生指著遠處的一個。
dis: What about that one over there?
what about 會念成 [hwɑ təˋbaʊt]，中間是 t；錄音裡是像 w 的音。
How about this one over there?
this 的母音是 [ɪ]，最後是 [s]；錄音裡是 that [ðæt]。
How about the one over there?
the 念成 [ðə]，沒有 [æ]，後面也沒有 t 那一下停頓；錄音裡是 that。

cards.ans: My neighbors played video games and kept me up all night.
cards.mark: My neighbors played video games and kept me up all night.
cards.key: me 和 up 中間多出一個像 y 的音，up all 又連在一起，聽起來像 [mi jʌ pɔl]。
cards.expl: kept me 的 t 夾在 [p] 和 [m] 中間，幾乎聽不到。keep someone up 是「讓人睡不著」；說話的人說早上沒辦法專心工作。
dis: My neighbors play video games and keep me up all night.
play 後面沒有 [d]，keep 的母音是長音 [i]；錄音裡是 played 和 kept [kɛpt]。
My neighbor played video games and kept me up all night.
neighbor 沒有最後的 [z]；錄音裡 neighbors 的 [z] 接在 played 前面。
My neighbors played video games and kept me awake all night.
awake 念成 [əˋwek]，me 後面接的是 [w]；錄音裡是 up [ʌp]，[p] 直接接上 all。

cards.ans: Actually, you do look kind of stressed out.
cards.mark: Actually, you do look kind of stressed out.
cards.key: look 的 [k] 和 kind 的 [k] 只念一次，聽起來像 [lʊ kaɪnd]。
cards.expl: kind of 說得快會念成 [ˋkaɪndə]，意思是「有點」；stressed out 的 [t] 接上 out，念成 [strɛs ˋtaʊt]。do 在這裡加重語氣，表示「真的看起來」。情境是男生說生物課快把他壓垮了。
dis: Actually, you look kind of stressed out.
少了 do；錄音裡 you 後面聽得到 [du]。
Actually, you do seem kind of stressed out.
seem 念成 [sim]，最後是閉上嘴唇的 [m]；錄音裡是 [lʊ kaɪnd]。
Actually, you do look kind of stressed.
少了 out；錄音裡 stressed 的 [t] 接上 out，聽起來像 [strɛs taʊt]。

cards.ans: How long will it take to close the account?
cards.mark: How long will it take to close the account?
cards.key: it 的 t 和 take 的 t 只念一次，聽起來像 [wɪlɪ tek]。
cards.expl: will it 也連在一起，念成 [ˋwɪlɪt]；close the account 的 the 在母音前念成 [ði]。情境是男生要搬回澳洲，到香港的銀行結清帳戶。
dis: How long does it take to close the account?
does it 念成 [ˋdʌzɪt]，中間有 [z]；錄音裡是 will 的 [l] 接 it。
How long will it take to close an account?
an account 會連成 [ənəˋkaʊnt]；錄音裡 close 後面是 the [ði]。
How long will it take to open the account?
open 念成 [ˋopən]，開頭是母音；錄音裡是 close [kloz]。

cards.ans: Why don’t you take that seat over there?
cards.mark: Why don’t you take that seat over there?
cards.key: don't 的 t 碰到 you，變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋdontʃu]。
cards.expl: take that 的 [k] 碰到 [ð]，省略不念；seat over 連在一起，t 念得像輕輕的 d，聽起來像 [si ˋdovɚ]。Why don't you…? 是在建議對方做某件事。
dis: Why didn’t you take that seat over there?
didn't 念成 [ˋdɪdn̩t]，母音是 [ɪ]；錄音裡是 don't 的 [o]。
Why won’t you take that seat over there?
won't 念成 [wont]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡是 [d]。
Why don’t we take that seat over there?
don't we 的 t 碰到 [w]，不會變成 [tʃ]；錄音裡是 [ˋdontʃu]。

cards.ans: Are you sure what you’re doing is not against the law?
cards.mark: Are you sure what you’re doing is not against the law?
cards.key: what 的 t 碰到 you're，變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋhwɑtʃɚ]。
cards.expl: you're 念得很輕，只剩 [jɚ]。情境是男生沒經過同意就在公共場所拍別人，女生擔心這樣違法。
dis: Are you sure what we’re doing is not against the law?
what we're 的 t 碰到 [w]，不會變成 [tʃ]；錄音裡是 [hwɑtʃɚ]。
Are you sure what you’re doing isn’t against the law?
isn't 念成 [ˋɪznt]，後面有 [nt]；錄音裡 is 和 not 分開念，聽得到 [ɪz nɑt]。
Are you sure what you’re doing is not against the rules?
rules 念成 [rulz]，開頭是 [r]；錄音裡句尾是 law [lɔ]。

cards.ans: Let me take down the details, and I’ll put out a call to our drivers.
cards.mark: Let me take down the details, and I’ll put out a call to our drivers.
cards.key: take 的 [k] 碰到 down 的 [d]，省略不念，聽起來像 [te daʊn]。
cards.expl: take down 是「記下來」。後面的 put out a 連成一串，t 念得像輕輕的 d，聽起來像 [pʊ daʊ də]。情境是計程車行的人要記下遺失物的細節，再通知司機。
dis: Let me write down the details, and I’ll put out a call to our drivers.
write down 念成 [raɪ daʊn]，母音是 [aɪ]；錄音裡是 [te]。
Let me take down your details, and I’ll put out a call to our drivers.
your 念成 [jɚ]；錄音裡 down 後面是 the [ðə]。
Let me take down the details, and I’ll put in a call to our drivers.
put in a 會連成 [pʊ dɪ nə]；錄音裡是 out [aʊt]。

cards.ans: Excuse me, I didn’t hear you quite clearly.
cards.mark: Excuse me, I didn’t hear you quite clearly.
cards.key: quite 的 t 碰到 clearly 的 [k]，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 [kwaɪ klɪrlɪ]。
cards.expl: didn't hear 的 t 也省略不念，念成 [ˋdɪdn̩ hɪr]。情境是病人沒聽清楚藥師說的話，再問一次藍色藥丸要飯前還是飯後吃。
dis: Excuse me, I didn’t hear you very clearly.
very 念成 [ˋvɛrɪ]，開頭是 [v]；錄音裡是 [kwaɪ]，接著又是 [k]。
Excuse me, I couldn’t hear you quite clearly.
couldn't 念成 [ˋkʊdn̩t]；錄音裡 I 後面是 didn't [ˋdɪdn̩t]。
Excuse me, I can’t hear you quite clearly.
can't 念成 [kænt]，是現在式；錄音裡是 didn't。

cards.ans: Then let’s get it for her.
cards.mark: Then let’s get it for her.
cards.kk: get it for her [gɛt] [ɪt] [fɔr] [hɝ] → [ˋgɛdɪt fɚ ɚ]
cards.key: her 的 h 不發音，for her 聽起來像 [fɚ ɚ]；get it 也連成 [ˋgɛdɪt]。
cards.expl: get 的 t 接上 it 的母音，念得像輕輕的 d；for 和 her 都念得很輕。情境是兩人挑禮物，決定就買那一個送給朋友。
dis: Then let’s get it for him.
him 的 h 不發音，念成 [ɪm]，最後要閉上嘴唇；錄音裡是捲舌的 [ɚ]。
Then let’s get one for her.
one 念成 [wʌn]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡 get 後面是 [ɪt]。
Then let’s buy it for her.
buy it 中間多出一個像 y 的音，念成 [baɪ jɪt]；錄音裡是 [gɛdɪt]。

cards.ans: I’m going to make a list of things to start doing.
cards.mark: I’m going to make a list of things to start doing.
cards.key: going to 說得快，會念成 [ˋgʌnə]，聽起來像 gonna。
cards.expl: make a list of 也連成一串，念成 [me kə ˋlɪstəv]，of 只剩 [əv]。情境是女生說暑假要改變生活方式，先列一張清單。
dis: I just want to make a list of things to start doing.
want to 說得快會念成 [ˋwɑnə]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡 I'm 後面是 [ˋgʌnə]。
I’m going to make lists of things to start doing.
lists 最後有 [ts]；錄音裡 make 後面有輕輕的 [ə]，list 是單數。
I’m going to make a list of things to stop doing.
stop 念成 [stɑp]；錄音裡是 start [stɑrt]，聽得到捲舌。

cards.ans: Just cut it before it gets cold.
cards.mark: Just cut it before it gets cold.
cards.key: cut 的 t 接上 it，念得像輕輕的 d，聽起來像 [ˋkʌdɪt]。
cards.expl: t 夾在兩個母音中間的時候，常常念成很快的輕 d。before it 也連在一起，念成 [bɪˋfɔrɪt]。情境是女生肚子很餓，催男生趕快切披薩。
dis: Just eat it before it gets cold.
eat it 念成 [ˋidɪt]，開頭是長音 [i]；錄音裡是 [kʌ]。
Just cut them before they get cold.
cut them 念成 [kʌt ðəm]，後面是 they get；錄音裡 cut 後面接 [ɪt]，接著是 it gets。
Just cut it before it’s cold.
少了 gets；錄音裡 it 後面聽得到 [gɛts]。

cards.ans: I’ll give it back to you on Friday.
cards.mark: I’ll give it back to you on Friday.
cards.key: give 的 [v] 接上 it，it 的 t 碰到 back 省略不念，聽起來像 [gɪvɪ bæk]。
cards.expl: to you 念得很輕，只剩 [tə jə]。情境是男生忘了帶午餐，跟女生借錢，說星期五還她。
dis: I’ll give them back to you on Friday.
them 念輕成 [ðəm]，give them 聽得到閉上嘴唇的 [m]；錄音裡 give 後面只有短短的 [ɪ]。
I’ll give it back to her on Friday.
her 念輕成 [ɚ]，to her 聽起來像 [tu ɚ]；錄音裡是 you 開頭像 y 的音。
I’d give it back to you on Friday.
I'd 的 [d] 碰到 give，只剩 [aɪ]；錄音裡句首是 [aɪl]，聽得到 [l]。

cards.ans: We got used to each other and didn’t see each other as often.
cards.mark: We got used to each other and didn’t see each other as often.
cards.key: see 和 each 中間多出一個像 y 的音，聽起來像 [si jitʃ ʌðɚ]。
cards.expl: 前面的 to each 中間多出的是像 w 的音，念成 [tu witʃ]；got used to 的 [d] 和 [t] 只念一次，念成 [gɑt ˋjustə]。說話的人在回想一段感情：兩人漸漸習慣了彼此，見面也沒那麼頻繁了。
dis: We got used to each other and didn’t see each other so often.
so 念成 [so]，開頭是 [s]；錄音裡 other 後面是 as [æz]。
We get used to each other and don’t see each other as often.
get 的母音是 [ɛ]，don't 的母音是 [o]；錄音裡是 got [gɑt] 和 didn't [ˋdɪdn̩t]。
We got used to each other and didn’t see each other that often.
that 開頭是 [ð]；錄音裡 other 後面是 as，連成 [ʌðɚ ræz]。

cards.ans: I told you it was a war movie.
cards.mark: I told you it was a war movie.
cards.key: you 和 it 中間多出一個像 w 的音，told you it 聽起來像 [ˋtoldʒu wɪt]。
cards.expl: told 的 [d] 碰到 you，也會變成 [dʒ]。was a 連在一起，念成 [wəzə]。情境是女生不喜歡戰爭片，男生說他早就說過這是戰爭片。
dis: I told you it’s a war movie.
it's a 念成 [ɪtsə]；錄音裡 it 後面是 was [wəz]。
I told her it was a war movie.
her 念輕成 [ɚ]，told her 聽起來像 [ˋtoldɚ]，沒有 [dʒ]；錄音裡是 [ˋtoldʒu]。
I told you this was a war movie.
this 開頭是 [ð]，最後是 [s]；錄音裡 you 後面是 [wɪt]。

cards.ans: I forgot to bring my lunch.
cards.mark: I forgot to bring my lunch.
cards.key: forgot 的 t 和 to 的 t 只念一次，聽起來像 [fɚgɑ tə]。
cards.expl: to 念得很輕，只剩 [tə]。情境是男生忘了帶午餐，想跟女生借錢。
dis: I forget to bring my lunch.
forget 的母音是 [ɛ]；錄音裡是張大嘴的 [ɑ]。
I forgot to buy my lunch.
buy 念成 [baɪ]；錄音裡是 bring [brɪŋ]，聽得到 [r] 和 [ŋ]。
I forgot to bring the lunch.
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡是 my [maɪ]。

cards.ans: I need some money now.
cards.mark: I need some money now.
cards.key: some 的 [m] 和 money 的 [m] 只念一次，聽起來像 [sʌ mʌnɪ]。
cards.expl: need some 的 [d] 碰到 [s]，也省略不念。這一句緊接在「忘了帶午餐」後面。
dis: I need the money now.
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 need 後面是 [s]。
I need some more money now.
more 念成 [mɔr]，會多出一個捲舌音；錄音裡 some 後面直接接 money。
I need my money now.
my 念成 [maɪ]；錄音裡是 [sʌ]。

cards.ans: Did you visit too many places?
cards.mark: Did you visit too many places?
cards.key: did 的 [d] 碰到 you，變成 [dʒ]，聽起來像 [ˋdɪdʒu]。
cards.expl: visit too 的 t 和 t 只念一次，念成 [ˋvɪzɪ tu]。情境是女生說日本之旅最後幾天有點累，男生問她是不是去了太多地方。
dis: Do you visit too many places?
do you 念成 [dəjə]，沒有 [dʒ]；錄音裡是 [ˋdɪdʒu]。
Did they visit too many places?
did they 的 [d] 碰到 [ð]，不會變成 [dʒ]；錄音裡是 [ˋdɪdʒu]。
Did you visit so many places?
so 念成 [so]；錄音裡是 too [tu]，t 和 visit 的 t 接在一起。

cards.ans: Is this your car?
cards.mark: Is this your car?
cards.key: this 的 [s] 碰到 your，變成 [ʃ]，聽起來像 [ðɪʃɚ]。
cards.expl: your 念得很輕，只剩 [jɚ]。情境是有人上前提醒車主：這裡是拖吊區，不能停車。
dis: Is that your car?
that 的母音是 [æ]，t 碰到 your 會變成 [tʃ]，念成 [ˋðætʃɚ]；錄音裡是 [ʃ]。
Is this her car?
her 念輕成 [ɚ]，this her 念成 [ˋðɪsɚ]，還是 [s]；錄音裡 [s] 已經變成 [ʃ]。
Is it your car?
it your 會念成 [ˋɪtʃɚ]，沒有 [ð]；錄音裡 is 後面是 this。

cards.ans: What seems to be the problem?
cards.mark: What seems to be the problem?
cards.key: what 的 t 碰到 seems 的 [s]，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 [hwɑ simz]。
cards.expl: seems to 的 to 念得很輕，只剩 [tə]。What seems to be the problem? 是診所常問的「哪裡不舒服」；情境是男生牙痛，到診所想看醫生。
dis: What seemed to be the problem?
seemed 最後是 [d]，接 to 念成 [simd tə]；錄音裡是 [z]。
What seems to be your problem?
your 念成 [jɚ]；錄音裡 be 後面是 the [ðə]。
What seem to be the problems?
seem 沒有 [z]，problems 最後多了 [z]；錄音裡是 seems，句尾是 problem。

cards.ans: Since you asked, I would say the dark blue suit looks best on you.
cards.mark: Since you asked, I would say the dark blue suit looks best on you.
cards.key: dark 的 [k] 碰到 blue 的 [b]，省略不念，聽起來像 [dɑr blu]。
cards.expl: Since you 的 [s] 碰到 you，變成 [ʃ]，念成 [ˋsɪnʃu]；best on 連在一起，念成 [ˋbɛstɑn]。情境是對方問穿哪一套好看，說話的人說深藍色那一套最適合。
dis: Since you asked, I would say the dark blue suit looked best on you.
looked 最後是 [t]，碰到 best 幾乎聽不到，要聽有沒有 looks 的 [s]；錄音裡是 [lʊks]。
Since you asked, I would say the dark blue shirt looks best on you.
shirt 念成 [ʃɝt]，有捲舌；錄音裡是 suit [sut]。
Since you asked, I would say the dark blue suits look best on you.
suits 最後是 [ts]，後面是 look；錄音裡 suit 後面是 looks [lʊks]。

cards.ans: You can pay me back tomorrow.
cards.mark: You can pay me back tomorrow.
cards.key: can 在句子裡念得很輕，只剩 [kən]，幾乎聽不到母音。
cards.expl: 要分辨 can 和 can't，聽母音：can 念輕成 [kən]，can't 念得比較重，母音是清楚的 [æ]。pay me 也連在一起，念成 [ˋpemi]。情境是女生借錢給男生，說明天再還她。
dis: You can’t pay me back tomorrow.
can't 念成 [kænt]，念得比較重，母音是清楚的 [æ]；錄音裡是輕輕的 [kən]。
You could pay me back tomorrow.
could 念成 [kʊd]；錄音裡是 [kən]，後面直接接 pay。
You can pay me back today.
today 念成 [təˋde]；錄音裡是 tomorrow [təˋmɑro]，聽得到 [m]。

cards.ans: Leave me out of it.
cards.mark: Leave me out of it.
cards.key: of 念得很輕，只剩 [əv]，out of it 連成一串，聽起來像 [aʊ dəvɪt]。
cards.expl: out 的 t 接上 of，念得像輕輕的 d。Leave me out of it. 是「別把我扯進去」；情境是男生煩惱要不要同時邀請兩個吵架的兄弟，女生不想插手。
dis: Leave me out of this.
this 開頭是 [ð]，最後是 [s]；錄音裡 of 後面是 [ɪt]。
Leave us out of it.
us 念成 [ʌs]，leave us 會連成 [ˋlivʌs]；錄音裡是 me [mi]。
Keep me out of it.
keep 念成 [kip]，開頭是 [k]，最後是 [p]；錄音裡是 leave [liv]。

cards.ans: Take a closer look.
cards.mark: Take a closer look.
cards.key: take 的 [k] 接上 a，聽起來像一個字 [ˋtekə]。
cards.expl: a 只念一個輕輕的 [ə]，很容易漏聽。closer 最後有捲舌的 [ɚ]，也要聽出來。情境是兩人看著小貓，男生要女生看仔細一點。
dis: Take a close look.
close 念成 [klos]，沒有最後的捲舌 [ɚ]；錄音裡是 closer [ˋklosɚ]。
Take another look.
another 念成 [əˋnʌðɚ]，中間有 [n] 和 [ð]；錄音裡 take a 後面是 [kl]。
Have a closer look.
have a 念成 [ˋhævə]；錄音裡句首是 take [tek]。

cards.ans: Can you turn on your camera?
cards.mark: Can you turn on your camera?
cards.key: turn 的 [n] 接上 on，聽起來像 [tɝ nɑn]。
cards.expl: Can you 念得又輕又快，只剩 [kənjə]；on your 也連在一起，念成 [ɑn jɚ]。情境是兩人在開視訊會議，女生聽得到男生，卻看不到他。
dis: Can you turn off your camera?
turn off 聽起來像 [tɝ nɔf]，最後是 [f]；錄音裡是 [nɑn]，最後是 [n]。
Could you turn on your camera?
could you 會連成 [ˋkʊdʒu]；錄音裡句首是 [kənjə]。
Can you turn on the camera?
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 on 後面是 your [jɚ]。

cards.ans: Why do you always arrive early for meetings?
cards.mark: Why do you always arrive early for meetings?
cards.key: you 和 always 中間多出一個像 w 的音，聽起來像 [ju wɔlwez]。
cards.expl: arrive early 也連在一起，arrive 的 [v] 接上 early，念成 [əˋraɪ ˋvɝlɪ]。情境是女生每次開會都提早到，男生問她為什麼。
dis: Why do you always arrive early to meetings?
to 念成 [tə]；錄音裡 early 後面是 for [fɚ]，聽得到 [f]。
Why did you always arrive early for meetings?
did you 會連成 [ˋdɪdʒu]；錄音裡是 do you。
Why do they always arrive early for meetings?
they always 中間多出的是像 y 的音，念成 [ðe jɔlwez]；錄音裡是 [ju wɔlwez]。

cards.ans: Children learn through play from the time they are very young.
cards.mark: Children learn through play from the time they are very young.
cards.key: they 和 are 中間多出一個像 y 的音，are 又念得很輕，聽起來像 [ðe jɚ]。
cards.expl: 兩個母音碰在一起，中間會自然帶出像 y 或 w 的音。這一段在介紹一本親子教養書，說孩子從很小就透過遊戲學習。
dis: Children learned through play from the time they were very young.
learned 最後有 [d]，were 念成 [wɚ]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡 they 後面是像 y 的音。
Children learn to play from the time they are very young.
to 念成 [tə]；錄音裡 learn 後面是 through [θru]，聽得到 [θr]。
Children learn through play from the time they are young.
少了 very；錄音裡 are 後面聽得到 [ˋvɛrɪ]。

cards.ans: I just tasted the soup.
cards.mark: I just tasted the soup.
cards.key: just 的 t 和 tasted 的 t 只念一次，聽起來像 [dʒʌs testɪd]。
cards.expl: tasted the 的 [d] 碰到 [ð]，也省略不念，聽起來像 [ˋtestɪ ðə]。情境是說話的人嘗了湯，問要不要再加點鹽。
dis: I just tested the soup.
tested 的母音是 [ɛ]，念成 [ˋtɛstɪd]；錄音裡是 taste 的 [e]。
I’ve just tasted the soup.
I've 最後有 [v]；錄音裡 I 後面直接接 just。
I just tasted this soup.
this 念成 [ðɪs]，最後有 [s]；錄音裡是 the [ðə]。

cards.ans: So, find the right time of day and stick to it.
cards.mark: So, find the right time of day and stick to it.
cards.key: right 的 t 和 time 的 t 只念一次，聽起來像 [raɪ taɪm]。
cards.expl: time of 連在一起，念成 [ˋtaɪməv]；stick to it 的 to 念得很輕，it 的 t 省略不念。這一段在談規律運動，最後建議找一天中固定的時段運動。
dis: So, find the right time of the day and stick to it.
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 of 後面直接接 day。
So, find the right time of day and stick with it.
with 念成 [wɪð]；錄音裡 stick 後面是 to [tə]。
So, find a right time of day and stick to it.
a 只念 [ə]；錄音裡 find 後面是 the [ðə]，聽得到 [ð]。

cards.ans: Don’t you think we’d better stay home?
cards.mark: Don’t you think we’d better stay home?
cards.key: don't 的 t 碰到 you，變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋdontʃu]。
cards.expl: we'd better 的 [d] 碰到 [b]，省略不念，聽起來像 we better。情境是天看起來要下雨，說話的人建議留在家裡。
dis: Don’t you think we should stay home?
should 念成 [ʃʊd]；錄音裡是 better [ˋbɛtɚ]。
Didn’t you think we’d better stay home?
didn't 念成 [ˋdɪdn̩t]，母音是 [ɪ]；錄音裡是 don't 的 [o]。
Don’t you think we’d rather stay home?
rather 念成 [ˋræðɚ]，開頭是 [r]；錄音裡是 [b]。

cards.ans: I hope I don’t find last year’s lunch in there.
cards.mark: I hope I don’t find last year’s lunch in there.
cards.key: last 的 t 碰到 year's，變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [læs tʃɪrz]。
cards.expl: don't find 的 t 碰到 [f]，省略不念；lunch in 連在一起，念成 [ˋlʌntʃɪn]。情境是弟弟從姊姊的書包翻出去年的課本和冬天的外套，姊姊開玩笑說希望別翻出去年的午餐。
dis: I hope I don’t find last week’s lunch in there.
week's 念成 [wiks]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡 last 後面是 [tʃɪrz]。
I hope I won’t find last year’s lunch in there.
won't 念成 [wont]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡 I 後面是 don't [dont]。
I hope I don’t find last year’s lunch in here.
here 念成 [hɪr]；錄音裡句尾是 there [ðɛr]，開頭是 [ð]。

cards.ans: I want the card to be plain.
cards.mark: I want the card to be plain.
cards.key: want 的 t 碰到 the，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 [wɑn ðə]。
cards.expl: card to 的 [d] 碰到 [t]，也省略不念。plain 是「樸素、沒有花樣」；情境是男生要設計名片，不要邊框。
dis: I wanted the card to be plain.
wanted 最後有 [ɪd]；錄音裡 want 後面直接接 the。
I want the card plain.
少了 to be；錄音裡 card 後面聽得到 [tə bi]。
I want the cards to be plain.
cards 最後有 [z]；錄音裡 card 後面直接接 to。

cards.ans: First, bake the chicken in the oven.
cards.mark: First, bake the chicken in the oven.
cards.key: bake 的 [k] 碰到 the，省略不念，聽起來像 [be ðə]。
cards.expl: chicken in 連在一起，念成 [ˋtʃɪkɪ nɪn]。情境是男生教朋友做這道雞肉料理，第一步先把雞肉放進烤箱烤。
dis: First, bake the chicken in an oven.
an oven 會連成 [əˋnʌvən]；錄音裡 in 後面是 the [ði]。
First, cook the chicken in the oven.
cook 念成 [kʊk]，開頭是 [k]；錄音裡是 [be]。
First, put the chicken in the oven.
put 念成 [pʊt]；錄音裡是 bake，母音是 [e]。

cards.ans: What do you have in there?
cards.mark: What do you have in there?
cards.key: do you 念得又輕又快，只剩 [dəjə]，what do you 聽起來像 [ˋhwɑdəjə]。
cards.expl: what 的 t 碰到 do，省略不念；have in 連在一起，念成 [hæ ˋvɪn]。情境是弟弟看姊姊的書包很重，問她裡面裝了什麼。
dis: What did you have in there?
did you 會連成 [ˋdɪdʒu]；錄音裡是輕輕的 [dəjə]。
What do you have in here?
here 念成 [hɪr]；錄音裡句尾是 there [ðɛr]。
What do they have in there?
they 念成 [ðe]，開頭是 [ð]；錄音裡 do 後面是 you [jə]。

cards.ans: It’s just part of our culture.
cards.mark: It’s just part of our culture.
cards.key: of 念得很輕，只剩 [əv]，part of our 連成一串，聽起來像 [pɑr də vaʊr]。
cards.expl: part 的 t 接上 of，念得像輕輕的 d。情境是女生說她的國家習慣提早到，這只是文化的一部分。
dis: It’s just part of their culture.
their 念成 [ðɛr]，開頭是 [ð]；錄音裡 of 的 [v] 直接接上 our。
It’s just a part of our culture.
just a 會連成 [ˋdʒʌstə]；錄音裡 just 後面直接接 part。
It’s just part of the culture.
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 of 後面是 our [aʊr]。

cards.ans: Should I take off my shoes?
cards.mark: Should I take off my shoes?
cards.key: take 的 [k] 接上 off，聽起來像 [te kɔf]。
cards.expl: Should I 也連在一起，念成 [ʃʊˋdaɪ]。情境是女生到朋友家，問進門要不要脫鞋。
dis: Should I take out my shoes?
out 念成 [aʊt]；錄音裡 take 後面是 [ɔf]，聽得到 [f]。
Shall I take off my shoes?
shall I 念成 [ʃəˋlaɪ]，中間是 [l]；錄音裡是 should 的 [d] 接到 I。
Should I take off the shoes?
the 會有 [ð]；錄音裡 off 後面是 my [maɪ]。

cards.ans: I want to open a savings account.
cards.mark: I want to open a savings account.
cards.key: savings 最後的 [z] 接到 account 上，聽起來像 [sevɪŋ zəkaʊnt]。
cards.expl: open a 也連在一起，念成 [ˋopənə]；want to 說得快，念成 [ˋwɑnə]。情境是男生到銀行，想開一個儲蓄帳戶。
dis: I want to open an account.
an account 會連成 [ənəˋkaʊnt]；錄音裡 open a 後面還有 [ˋsevɪŋz]。
I want to close a savings account.
close 念成 [kloz]；錄音裡 to 後面是 open [ˋopən]，開頭是母音。
I’d like to open a savings account.
I'd like 念成 [aɪd laɪk]；錄音裡是 want to [ˋwɑnə]。

cards.ans: Okay, okay, I’ll give it a try if you insist.
cards.mark: Okay, okay, I’ll give it a try if you insist.
cards.key: you 和 insist 中間多出一個像 w 的音，聽起來像 [ju wɪnsɪst]。
cards.expl: give it a 連成一串，念成 [ˋgɪvɪtə]；give it a try 是「試試看」。情境是男生第一次煮湯，一直要女生喝一口，她只好答應。
dis: Okay, okay, I’ll give it a try since you insist.
since you 會念成 [ˋsɪnʃu]，前面有 [s]；錄音裡是 if [ɪf]。
Okay, okay, I’ll give it a try if you like.
like 念成 [laɪk]；錄音裡 you 後面是像 w 的音接 [ɪnsɪst]。
Okay, okay, I’ll give it another try if you insist.
another 念成 [əˋnʌðɚ]；錄音裡 it 後面只有輕輕的 [ə]，接著就是 try。

cards.ans: It’s your responsibility to pay attention.
cards.mark: It’s your responsibility to pay attention.
cards.key: pay 和 attention 中間多出一個像 y 的音，聽起來像 [pe jətɛnʃən]。
cards.expl: It's your 的 [s] 碰到 your，變成 [ʃ]，念成 [ˋɪtʃɚ]。情境是員警攔下男生，說他在商業區違規左轉，注意交通號誌是駕駛的責任。
dis: It’s our responsibility to pay attention.
our 念成 [aʊr]，it's our 會連成 [ɪtˋsaʊr]；錄音裡是 [ˋɪtʃɚ]。
It’s your responsibility to pay more attention.
more 念成 [mɔr]；錄音裡 pay 後面是像 y 的音，接著就是 attention。
It was your responsibility to pay attention.
it was 念成 [ɪt wəz]；錄音裡句首是 it's [ɪts]。

cards.ans: Don’t worry, I’ll take care of that.
cards.mark: Don’t worry, I’ll take care of that.
cards.key: take 的 [k] 和 care 的 [k] 只念一次，聽起來像 [te kɛr]。
cards.expl: care of 連在一起，念成 [ˋkɛrəv]，of 只剩 [əv]。情境是男生想躲一位客戶，請女生幫忙應付，女生說交給她處理。
dis: Don’t worry, I’ll take care of it.
of it 會連成 [əvɪt]；錄音裡 of 後面是 that [ðæt]。
Don’t worry, we’ll take care of that.
we'll 念成 [wil]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡是 I'll [aɪl]。
Don’t worry, I’d take care of that.
I'd 的 [d] 碰到 take，只剩 [aɪ]；錄音裡聽得到 I'll 的 [l]。

cards.ans: I can’t wait to sign up for these courses.
cards.mark: I can’t wait to sign up for these courses.
cards.key: wait 的 t 和 to 的 t 只念一次，聽起來像 [we tə]。
cards.expl: can't wait 的 t 碰到 [w]，省略不念，這時要靠 can't 念得比較重、母音 [æ] 比較清楚來分辨；sign up 連在一起，念成 [saɪ ˋnʌp]。情境是男生要開烘焙學校，很想報名創業課程。
dis: I can’t wait to sign up for those courses.
those 念成 [ðoz]，母音是 [o]；錄音裡 for 後面是 these [ðiz]。
I can’t wait to sign up for the course.
course 沒有最後的 [ɪz]；錄音裡句尾是 courses [ˋkɔrsɪz]。
I can’t wait to sign up for this course.
this course 念成 [ðɪs kɔrs]；錄音裡是 these courses，句尾有 [ɪz]。

cards.ans: Sorry to have kept you waiting.
cards.mark: Sorry to have kept you waiting.
cards.key: kept 的 t 碰到 you，變成 [tʃ]，聽起來像 [ˋkɛptʃu]。
cards.expl: to have 念得很輕，聽起來像 [tə həv]。Sorry to have kept you waiting. 是讓人久等時的道歉；情境是銀行行員向等了很久的客人說抱歉。
dis: Sorry to keep you waiting.
keep 的母音是長音 [i]，keep you 念成 [ˋkipju]；錄音裡是 [ˋkɛptʃu]，前面還有 to have。
Sorry for keeping you waiting.
keeping 念成 [ˋkipɪŋ]，前面是 for；錄音裡是 to have kept。
Sorry to have kept them waiting.
them 念輕成 [ðəm]，kept them 聽得到 [ð]；錄音裡是 [tʃ]。

cards.ans: I’m afraid you have to come back again.
cards.mark: I’m afraid you have to come back again.
cards.key: afraid 的 [d] 碰到 you，變成 [dʒ]，聽起來像 [əˋfredʒu]。
cards.expl: have to 說得快，念成 [ˋhæftə]；come back 的 [m] 碰到 [b]，接得很緊。I'm afraid… 是委婉地說壞消息；情境是男生要開戶，卻只帶了一種證件，行員請他改天再來。
dis: I’m afraid you’ll have to come back again.
you'll 最後有 [l]，接 have 念成 [jul hæv]；錄音裡是 [dʒu hæftə]。
I’m afraid we have to come back again.
we 開頭是 [w]，afraid we 不會變成 [dʒ]；錄音裡是 [əˋfredʒu]。
I’m afraid you have to come back later.
later 念成 [ˋletɚ]；錄音裡是 again [əˋgɛn]。

cards.ans: Do you realize that you just turned left in the business zone?
cards.mark: Do you realize that you just turned left in the business zone?
cards.key: turned 的 [d] 碰到 left 的 [l]，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 turn left。
cards.expl: 聽不出 -ed 的時候，可以靠前面的 just 知道這是剛剛發生的事。just turned 的 t 也省略不念；left in 連在一起，念成 [lɛfˋtɪn]。情境是員警攔下違規左轉的男生。
dis: Do you realize that you’ve just turned left in the business zone?
you've 最後有 [v]；錄音裡 you 後面直接接 just [dʒʌs]。
Did you realize that you just turned left in the business zone?
did you 會連成 [ˋdɪdʒu]；錄音裡句首是 do you [dəjə]。
Do you realize that you just turned left at the business zone?
at the 的 t 省略不念，念成 [æ ðə]；錄音裡 left 的 t 接上 in，聽得到 [n]。

cards.ans: It doesn’t last forever.
cards.mark: It doesn’t last forever.
cards.key: last 的 t 夾在 [s] 和 [f] 中間，幾乎聽不到，聽起來像 [læs fɚɛvɚ]。
cards.expl: doesn't 的 t 碰到 last，也省略不念，念成 [ˋdʌzn̩ læs]。it 指的是防曬乳：效果不會一直持續，所以一天要擦不只一次。
dis: It didn’t last forever.
didn't 念成 [ˋdɪdn̩t]，母音是 [ɪ]；錄音裡是 doesn't 的 [ʌ] 接 [z]。
It won’t last forever.
won't 念成 [wont]，開頭是 [w]；錄音裡是 doesn't [ˋdʌzn̩t]。
They don’t last forever.
they don't 念成 [ðe dont]，開頭是 [ð]；錄音裡句首是 it [ɪt]。

cards.ans: He’s causing trouble and I want to avoid him for a day or two.
cards.mark: He’s causing trouble and I want to avoid him for a day or two.
cards.key: him 的 h 不發音，for a 連成 [fɚrə]，avoid him for a 聽起來像 [əvɔɪdɪm fɚrə]。
cards.expl: avoid 的 [d] 接上 [ɪm]；want to 說得快，念成 [ˋwɑnə]。情境是男生有一位難搞的客戶，想躲他一兩天。
dis: He’s causing trouble and I want to avoid her for a day or two.
her 念輕成 [ɚ]，avoid her 聽起來像 [əˋvɔɪdɚ]，是捲舌音；錄音裡是閉上嘴唇的 [ɪm]。
He’s causing trouble and I want to avoid them for a day or two.
them 念輕成 [ðəm]，聽得到 [ð]；錄音裡 avoid 的 [d] 直接接 [ɪm]。
He’s causing trouble and I want to avoid him for a week or two.
week 念成 [wik]；錄音裡是 day [de]。

cards.ans: Okay, but I’ll take them off if you don’t mind.
cards.mark: Okay, but I’ll take them off if you don’t mind.
cards.key: them 念得很輕，只剩 [əm]，take them off 聽起來像 [tekə mɔf]。
cards.expl: them 的 [ð] 常常聽不到，[m] 又接上 off，所以很容易聽成別的字。if you 也連在一起，念成 [ɪfju]。情境是女生習慣進門脫鞋，them 指的就是她的鞋子。
dis: Okay, but I’ll take it off if you don’t mind.
take it off 會連成 [teˋkɪ tɔf]，中間是 [t]；錄音裡是閉上嘴唇的 [m]。
Okay, but I will take them off if you don’t mind.
I will 分開念，will 開頭是 [w]；錄音裡是縮寫 I'll [aɪl]。
Okay, but I’ll keep them on if you don’t mind.
keep them on 念成 [ˋkipəmɑn]，開頭是 [k]、最後是 [ɑn]；錄音裡是 take 和 off。
